correction_and_conflict_search: Exact-title/DOI correction and retraction searches plus Crossref registration checks for both accepted primary studies found no corresponding notice in returned coverage. Crossref update-to absent/relation empty is not an exhaustive corrections registry. A different TiO2 B. subtilis MTCC8322 2024 paper surfaced as retracted and was not adopted. Ti oxygen-dependence 2024 study is a conditional-effect lead, not directly transferable proof or refutation of 2026 arms.

deferred.reason: Candida tropicalis biosorption promising but publisher fulltext403; bibliographic record and publisher abstract/snippets do not support full protocol curation.
Fusarium zirconia stronger mechanistic lead but both RSC fulltext routes403; publisher metadata and surfaced author-posted excerpts are not a inspected full primary PDF.

Full PMC XML inspected; B. mycoides particle synthesis lacks matched synthesis blank and direct crystallographic phase evidence. Ti2026 selected for more informative perturbations/controls. Repository PDF route returned HTML challenge, not PDF.
Full PDF acquired; abstract, methods and conclusion inspected for oxygen-dependence context, but no full figure or supplement audit. Do not transfer its 25C, inoculum or oxygen settings into 2026.
